quote.text: I keep getting charged for subscriptions I forgot about

promise.text: How to find all your subscriptions, including annual ones

lines.text: A twelve month statement sweep, plus the places charges hide: Apple and Google lists, PayPal, old cards and free trials that turned into paid plans.

head.text: Download twelve months of statements for every credit card, debit card and checking account you've used.

body.text: Most banks let you pick a date range or download a CSV.
If yours only keeps a few months online, ask for older statements.

head.text: Search or scan each statement for repeats.

body.text: Sorting by merchant name puts the same company next to itself.
Write down anything that appears two or more times at the same or a similar amount.

line.text: Subscriptions are their own area, with amounts and renewal dates, and a missing renewal date shows up in Attention rather than being quietly ignored.

title.text: How to find all your subscriptions, including annual ones
